description: This file is a header (.h) defining Wi-Fi Access Point (AP) related structures, enums, function prototypes, and callback types for a Wi-Fi HAL interface. It includes definitions for traffic stats, security settings, associated devices, and various configuration functions for Wi-Fi APs.

classes.name: wifi_associated_dev_t
classes.description: Structure representing details of a Wi-Fi client device associated with an Access Point, including MAC address, IP, signal strength, data rates, and various counters and status indicators.

methods.name: wifi_getWifiTrafficStats
methods.description: Retrieves detailed traffic statistics for a specified access point index.

methods.name: wifi_factoryResetAP
methods.description: Resets the specified Access Point's parameters to factory defaults without affecting other AP or radio settings.

methods.name: wifi_deleteAp
methods.description: Deletes the specified Access Point entry on hardware and clears associated variables.

methods.name: wifi_getApName
methods.description: Retrieves the name associated with the specified Access Point.

methods.name: wifi_radiusEapFailure_callback
methods.description: Callback invoked upon a radius or EAP failure event, providing AP index and failure reason.

methods.name: wifi_radiusEapFailure_callback_register
methods.description: Registers the callback function for radius/EAP failure events.

methods.name: wifi_apDisassociatedDevice_callback_register
methods.description: Registers callback for disassociated device events.

methods.name: wifi_apDeAuthEvent_callback
methods.description: Callback invoked upon DeAuth events, providing AP index, client MAC, and reason.

methods.name: wifi_apDeAuthEvent_callback_register
methods.description: Registers callback for DeAuth events.

methods.name: wifi_setInterworkingAccessNetworkType
methods.description: Sets the interworking access network type for a specified AP.

methods.name: wifi_getInterworkingAccessNetworkType
methods.description: Gets the current interworking access network type for a specified AP.

methods.name: wifi_getApInterworkingServiceEnable
methods.description: Retrieves whether the AP's interworking service is enabled.

methods.name: wifi_setApInterworkingServiceEnable
methods.description: Enables or disables the interworking service on an AP.

methods.name: wifi_getApInterworkingElement
methods.description: Retrieves the current interworking element configured for the AP.

methods.name: wifi_pushApInterworkingElement
methods.description: Pushes a new interworking element configuration to the AP.

methods.name: wifi_getP2PCrossConnect
methods.description: Checks if P2P cross connect is disabled.

methods.name: wifi_setP2PCrossConnect
methods.description: Disables or enables P2P cross connect.

methods.name: wifi_getTWTsessions
methods.description: Retrieves all connected TWT sessions for an AP.

methods.name: wifi_getBroadCastSession
methods.description: Creates or updates a broadcast TWT session.

methods.name: wifi_setBroadcastTWTSchedule
methods.description: Creates or updates broadcast TWT schedule.

methods.name: wifi_teardownTWTSession
methods.description: Tears down a specified TWT session.

methods.name: wifi_createVAP
methods.description: Creates a Virtual Access Point (VAP) on a specified radio index.

methods.name: wifi_getRadioVapInfoMap
methods.description: Retrieves the VAP info map for a radio.

methods.name: wifi_setApSecurity
methods.description: Configures security settings for an AP.

methods.name: wifi_getApSecurity
methods.description: Retrieves security settings for an AP.

methods.name: wifi_getAPCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves capabilities of the AP.

methods.name: wifi_getApWpsConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves current WPS configuration for an AP.

methods.name: wifi_setApWpsConfiguration
methods.description: Sets WPS configuration for an AP.

methods.name: wifi_getLibhostapd
methods.description: Checks if libhostapd is enabled.

methods.name: wifi_updateLibHostApdConfig
methods.description: Updates the hostapd configuration for an AP.

methods.name: wifi_vapstatus_callback
methods.description: Callback invoked when VAP status changes (up/down).

methods.name: wifi_vapstatus_callback_register
methods.description: Registers callback for VAP status change events.

methods.name: wifi_hal_analytics_callback_register
methods.description: Registers callback for logging catastrophic failures.

methods.name: wifi_mgmt_frame_callbacks_register
methods.description: Registers callbacks for management frame processing.

methods.name: wifi_csi_callback_register
methods.description: Registers callback for CSI data.

methods.name: wifi_hal_register_frame_hook
methods.description: Registers a frame hook callback for received management frames.

methods.name: wifi_enableCSIEngine
methods.description: Enables or disables CSI engine data for a specific station on a VAP.

methods.name: wifi_sendDataFrame
methods.description: Sends a data frame to an associated client or broadcast.

methods.name: wifi_sendActionFrame
methods.description: Transmits an action frame to a station.

methods.name: wifi_applyGASConfiguration
methods.description: Applies GAS (Generic Advertisement Service) configuration.

methods.name: wifi_setCountryIe
methods.description: Sets the Country code IE in Beacon and Probe Response.

methods.name: wifi_getCountryIe
methods.description: Retrieves the status of Country code IE in Beacon.

methods.name: wifi_setLayer2TrafficInspectionFiltering
methods.description: Enables/Disables Layer 2 traffic inspection and filtering.

methods.name: wifi_getLayer2TrafficInspectionFiltering
methods.description: Retrieves the status of Layer 2 traffic inspection and filtering.

methods.name: wifi_setDownStreamGroupAddress
methods.description: Enables/disables DownStream Group Address (DGAF).

methods.name: wifi_getDownStreamGroupAddress
methods.description: Retrieves status of DownStream Group Address (DGAF).

methods.name: wifi_setBssLoad
methods.description: Enables/disables BSS Load Information Element.

methods.name: wifi_getBssLoad
methods.description: Retrieves status of BSS Load IE.

methods.name: wifi_setProxyArp
methods.description: Enables/disables Proxy ARP.

methods.name: wifi_getProxyArp
methods.description: Retrieves Proxy ARP status.

methods.name: wifi_pushApHotspotElement
methods.description: Sets Hotspot 2.0 status.

methods.name: wifi_getApHotspotElement
methods.description: Retrieves Hotspot 2.0 status.

methods.name: wifi_pushApRoamingConsortiumElement
methods.description: Pushes Roaming Consortium IE contents.

methods.name: wifi_getApRoamingConsortiumElement
methods.description: Retrieves Roaming Consortium IE contents.
